name: OPRO (Optimization by PROmpting)
one_liner: Uses an LLM as an iterative black-box optimizer conditioned on a sorted trajectory of (solution, objective-score) pairs evaluated by an external oracle.

loop.proposes: An optimizer LLM proposes K new candidate solutions (routes, linear regression weights, or instructions) given the top-scoring history.
loop.judged_by: An exact objective evaluator computes the ground-truth cost (TSP tour length, MSE loss, or training accuracy) for every candidate.
loop.steers: The newly scored candidates are inserted into the sorted priority buffer, shifting the optimization window toward better objective values.

headline_result: Discovered prompts that boosted GSM8K accuracy by up to 8 percentage points over human baselines and solved small-scale TSP and linear regression trajectories.
caveat: On large combinatorial instances (>50 TSP nodes), in-context coordinate proposals lag far behind dedicated Concorde or LKH solvers.
beyond_harness_note: An external objective evaluator scores every proposed candidate and maintains the sorted optimization trajectory buffer.
algorithmic_authority: Exact objective function evaluator and sorted trajectory buffer

sources.title: Large Language Models as Optimizers (ICLR 2024 / arXiv:2309.03409)

verification.notes: Checked against Yang et al., ICLR 2024.
